title: It's a Wonderful Life
synopsis: A small-town banker on a bridge, an angel earning his wings, and a Christmas Eve that becomes a ledger of every kindness you forgot doing.

nodes.text: The whole town files past with what they can spare. Harry toasts you. A bell rings. Zuzu says it means an angel got his wings. The road into No Man Is a Failure began with “Hold Mary” in Living Room; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

You sit on the floor with the children and you do not look at the basket of money for a long time. You just look at them. The road into Quiet Christmas began with “Stand still” in Living Room; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

Across town, an old man in a wheelchair sits with a stolen bundle on his desk and does not, for the first time, count it. The road into Potter, Alone began with “Take the third path” in Living Room; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
